concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-control-panel-users-roles-scim-scim-faq]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree SCIM operations FAQ for IdP-controlled SSO-user lifecycle and group-backed role, merchant-account and API-access membership, with Control Panel ownership of non-SSO users and role/account structure; preserves provider-specific lifecycle limits, destructive Push Groups warnings and the page's one-way-onboarding versus assisted-roll-off tension
warnings: The raw says onboarding is a one-way street but later says Braintree can roll a merchant off; the source entry narrows this to Braintree-assisted exception handling and does not infer self-service or lossless reversal.
This collected FAQ is not proof of current merchant eligibility, successful synchronization, lifecycle completion or a broader SCIM policy beyond Braintree's described integration.
